title: I hate that you can only have 6 habits.
body: This is the best app ever but it really frustrating that you only can have six habits at the time. I wanna add more. I want to see everything I have accomplished on that day not only six things. Please add more habits to the app. Unfortunately I will have to use another app with more habits to track.

author: Jack Daniels the great

title: Insane price model
body:
The app is really polished and nice. A nice way to track your habits after reading the Atomic Habits book.
However. The price to unlock the pro version (which is required to track more than 1 habit) is completely insane! 129 SEK per MONTH for a glorified checkbox? What?!
author: Onkel Pwnas

title: Easy and supportive
body: I really like the simplicity yet challenging approach of this app. It helps me to stay committed and support me when I do so.
author: Happyhappsonfilur

title: Too many notifications
body: My lock screen is filled with notifications from Atoms. It’s red flag to me. Overall, this app is helpful and also works as a reminder, tips, progress tracker, and habit journal. I like using it because I can track my habits easily. Also I like James Clear
author: Azizq33

title: Straightforward, simple, and great!
body:
I’m currently reading through Atomic Habits for the first time, and just got the email from James’ newsletter about his app. 

It’s wonderful! Love the design, the simplicity, and the satisfaction of holding in the atom once a habit has been completed.
author: Davy1242

title: one of a kind
body:
the app is BEAUTIFUL.
It has and incredibly easy and powerful way to guide you to create and stick to habits. If you ever saw any content from James Clear, you can feel that his presence is in every corner of this app.
